title: Proof of q zero complex extension
html:
Proof. Proof of q zero complex extension

Proof

Each substrate identity is stated in the cited literature (Wenzl 1988; Jones 1987) over a commutative ring with q a unit; the QOU formalisation enforces the same generic typing. The relevant Lean files (hq-bi-filtration.lean, explicit-central-idempotent.lean, categorical-q-lie-bracket.lean, bar-involution.lean) all carry {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (or stronger) and {q : R} without an ordering predicate.

The condition \lvert q \rvert > 1 on \mathbb{C} is sufficient to make q a unit (since \lvert q \rvert > 0 implies q \neq 0), so the existing polymorphic identities specialize. \quad\square
